title: An executable whose compiled modules differ from the record is refused
given: An executable's compiled module list and a record.
when: A checksum is missing or wrong, a version or the main module differs, a module is extra, or a dependency is missing.
notes: Not proof yet: Verify's check of the executable's digest, size and binary settings is not exercised.

title: A source snapshot is refused on any changed, missing or added file
given: A source snapshot that matches its record.
when: Any one file changes, goes missing or is added.
then: VerifySource accepts the original and refuses each change.
notes: Not proof yet: see ST-BLD-DS02-T01 for the executable.

title: An image is refused when any digest its record names differs
given: An image layout that matches its record.
when: An extra file or link, changed config bytes, a missing blob, a wrong application or CA digest, a wrong diff ID, a dirty packer or a duplicate index key.
then: VerifyImage refuses each with its own reason.

title: Each component generator returns the same files for the same inputs
given: The ten plans of each built-in archetype that ST-STD-GEN-R03-T01 makes.
when: Compares the generator files of the plans, without main.go and go.mod.
then: Expects the same files with the same content in every plan.
notes: Not proof yet, for the same reason as ST-STD-GEN-R03-T01: 16 of the 26 components are not reached. That the generator receives only its context is shown by ST-STD-GEN-R01-T01 and ST-STD-GEN-R02-T01.

title: The assembler writes the same main.go and go.mod for the same wirings
given: The ten plans of each built-in archetype that ST-STD-GEN-R03-T01 makes.
when: Compares main.go and go.mod across the plans.
then: Expects the same content in every plan.
notes: One assembler serves every archetype, and the three archetypes give it wirings with routes, middleware, processes and a database.
